units.source_text: 我立即回到父亲的家中。

en.t: I immediately returned to my father's house.

units.source_text: 母亲的遗体还没从医院运回家里。

en.t: My mother's body had not yet been brought home from the hospital.

units.source_text: 我同家里不通音讯，对母亲患病一无所知。

en.t: I had been out of touch with my family and knew nothing about my mother's illness.

units.source_text: 母亲是因舌癌而死去的。

en.t: My mother had died of tongue cancer.

units.source_text: 她按住咽喉，就是让我看的吧。

en.t: When she pressed her hand to her throat, she must have been trying to show me.
